notes.title: The Guise - Progress Update #6
The Guise - Progress Update #5
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there![/h3]

In this weekly progress update we'd like to share with you the latest news of the game development.

[list]
[*] Completed work on in-game amulets that enhance the character (9 amulets in total);
[*] Finished working on in-game balance edits (economy, character ability improvements, and game difficulty);
[*] Polishing all aspects of the game, bug fixes, and gameplay improvements;
[*] All in-game texts were localized.
[/list]

Additional:
[list]
[*] Upgrades to the player's abilities in Mallory's cave;
[*] Improved the mechanics of abilities on pumped levels;
[*] Full-fledged Russian localization.
[/list]

Thank you for staying, see you in the next update!

Yours,
The Guise Dev. Team

notes.title: The Guise Discord Q&A session
notes.notes:
Hello there!

In connection with the Steam Game Festival, we are also launching a Q&A session with the developer of the Guise!

We would like to invite you on 10.09 Friday from 2:00 AM (PDT) to 11:00 AM (PDT) in our discord channel where this event will be held in text format. 

Link to join the Guise discord: https://discord.gg/ffASSDQ

Thanks for your support!

Sincerely,
The Guise Dev. Team

notes.title: The Guise Steam Game Festival Live Stream
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We are happy to announce our participation in the Steam Game Festival!

In connection with this event, we encourage everyone who follows our game to join the Guise Steam Game Festival Live Stream.
The broadcast will be on Steam from Friday 2:00 AM (PDT) to Sunday 11:00 AM (PDT).

It will be interesting and informative, we're waiting for all of you to come!

Thank you for staying with us!

Sincerely,
The Guise Dev. Team

notes.title: The Guise - Progress Update #4
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there![/h3]

In this weekly progress update we'd like to share with you the latest news of the game development.

Fully updated 6-8 optional side quests:
[list]
[*] New mini-bosses for side quests (~4 mini-bosses);
[*] New cut scenes and dialogs for side quests;
[*] Worked out the reward for completing side quests (amulets, in-game currency).
[/list]

Finished working on mobs for all empty areas:
[list]
[*] For the Upper Gooseville area - 5 new mobs and 2-3 new types of traps;
[*] For the Catacombs area - 5 new mobs;
[*] For the Sunken area - 7 new mobs.
[/list]

Thank you for staying, see you in the next update!

Yours,
The Guise Dev. Team

notes.title: The Guise - Progress Update #3
The Guise - Progress Update #2
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there![/h3]

In this weekly progress update we'd like to share with you the latest news of the game development.

Finished the main storyline of the game (quest "Become the human"):
[list]
[*] Added action sequences for getting two endings and the ability to choose between one of the two final bosses;
[*] The main story updated with new cut scenes.
[/list]

Some new in-game Bosses:
[list]
[*] Gravedigger for the Catacombs area (killing which gives a boat ticket to go to the Sunken Village area in the game plot);
[*] Shaman for the Sunken Village area (final boss for ending #1);
[*] Secret Boss for the Sunken Village area (final boss for ending #2).
[/list]

Thank you for staying, see you in the next update!

Yours,
The Guise Dev. Team

notes.title: The Guise - Progress Update #1
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there![/h3]

In this weekly progress update we'd like to share with you the latest news of the game development.

Finished working on the game world:

[list]
[*] New Upper Gooseville area (13 levels);
[*] Improved and finished the Valley of Demons area (12 levels);
[*] Modified the final area of Sunken Village (20 levels);
[*] Relationships between all areas have been worked out.
[/list]

And there are some new bosses added as well:

[list]
[*] New boss (Mayor Odran) for the Upper Gooseville area
[*] New boss (Deloris) for the Valley of Demons area
[/list]

Thank you for staying, and see you in the next update!

Yours,
The Guise Dev. Team

notes.title: The Guise demo is out!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, guys, the latest demo of The Guise is on Steam.[/b]

Demo build features 20 levels to explore and takes around 30 minutes to play through,

[previewyoutube=tuTwsFWzBHk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Known issues, based on already received feedback:[/b]
[list][*]Dull combats
[*]Too basic structure of the game world
[/list]

I'm working on solving the first issue right now and this is what the solution actually looks like:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Gsrjfjz/gif120.gif[/img]

I'll be updating the demo and collecting your feedback, so if you have ideas or suggestions feel free to share them with me here on steam forums.

Cheers,
Rasul Mono
